    if (codeString) {
      try {
        target.innerHTML = '';
        const graph = new Function('Plot', 'd3', `return ${codeString}`)(Plot, d3);
        
        if (graph) {
          target.appendChild(graph);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to render OJS code for card:", e);
      }
    }
  });
